headline: Colombia Senate Committee Approves UAE Trade Pact Cutting 85% of Tariffs
summary: Colombia's Senate approved the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement with the United Arab Emirates in its first debate, granting tariff-free access to 85% of Colombian goods.
why: The CEPA expands trade channels between Latin American agribusiness and Middle Eastern markets, facilitating foreign direct investment.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Bilateral trade agreement eliminates tariffs on 85% of exports entering the UAE market.
